frontmatter.audience: SDK authors whose SDK runs a one-shot command or a long-running service that needs a user's credential at runtime, and who must choose how the SDK receives it without shipping or logging the value. Assumes they already declare plugs and write runtime hooks.
frontmatter.notes: Anchor how_use_secrets. Index entry 'Use secrets in an SDK <use-secrets>' goes alphabetically in the develop-sdks toctree. Cross-links: one pointer sentence in declare-plugs-slots.rst next to the line scoping its examples to mount and tunnel, and one in the 'System services' section of best-practices.rst, both pointing to how_use_secrets. use-secrets links one-way to how_provide_secrets for the user side; provide-secrets does not link back.
